remarks: Large, single-level 3 BR/2 Bath condo rental in beautiful, well-managed & sunny garden style building. Updated kitchen and baths. Hardwood floors, 9ft ceilings, gas stove and plenty of storage. Heat, hot water, and 3-car parking included in rent. No extras fees for trash, water, amenities or parking. Courtyard gardens. Plots assigned for vegetable & flower gardening. Conveniently located in Stamford downtown within walking distance to UCONN, train, shops, bars, restaurants, and several parks. Laundry In Building. Pets allowed with owner approval. Bike and extra storage in the garage. Walk to dining, shopping, train (50 Minutes to NYC), public transportation. Great community with a responsive landlord. Good credit and references required. No exceptions. Please note that the advertised price is the actual monthly rental price. It is not based on any "free month" promotions.
